I teach quantitative methods and organizational behavior at the [TUM School of
Management](https://www.mgt.tum.de/) and supervise bachelor's and master's theses on
motivation, negotiation, and personnel selection.

## Courses

### Introduction to Statistics Using R

*Lecture, master's programme — since 2020*

An applied introduction to statistical analysis in R for students without a programming
background: data handling, estimation and inference, regression, and the reporting
conventions of empirical management research.

### Organizational Behavior

*Co-teaching, bachelor's programme — since 2019*

Core theory and evidence on motivation, leadership, teams, and decision making in
organizations.

## Thesis supervision

Since 2019 I have supervised more than 30 master's theses and 5 bachelor's theses.

Topics I am glad to supervise include implicit and explicit motives, negotiation behavior,
personnel decisions and selection, perceived listening at work, and social networks in
organizations, as well as methodological projects in R. If you would like to work on
something in this space, e-mail me at [cafer.bakac@tum.de](mailto:cafer.bakac@tum.de) with
a short description of the question you want to pursue.

## Workshops

I also run methods workshops for researchers and practitioners — see the
[workshops page](../workshops/index.qmd).
